releases.title: Snake v0.2.0 — test hooks, clean console
releases.author: game-developer
releases.body:
Snake v0.2.0: game-developer 78f16e43e892da6e97db091d3eb93d128a8b45ed + artist assets 168dbb55bb376666aa61632057c92f126ef20e2f (the delivery as `ht-role delivery` assembles it).

**Start it:** download `snake-v0.2.0.zip`, unzip, open `snake/index.html` in a browser (or run `python3 -m http.server` in `snake/` and open http://localhost:8000/). No install, no build.

**Controls:** Enter/Space/click (or an arrow key) start · arrow keys turn · P/Esc pause · Enter/Space/R/click play again · M sound.

**Changes since v0.1.0:** no more console errors (the game requests only the asset files the artist delivers); read-only test hooks `window.__snake` (state, score, snake, food, grid), `data-state`/`data-score` on the canvas, and `?speed=<ms>` to fix the tick length, documented in `docs/testing.md`.

**Checked on the unzipped release, headless Chromium (Playwright 1.64):** `tests/test_game.py` 26/26 (movement, four turns, reverse ignored, +1 length and +1 point per food, food off the snake, wall and self game over, final score, replay by Enter and click resets score/length, arrow keys don't scroll, hooks); `tests/test_play.py` real-time keyboard-only play at `?speed=90`: 5 foods eaten (length 3+score throughout), wall death, Enter replay with score 0 and length 3, no console errors.

releases.title: Snake v0.1.0 — first playable build
releases.author: game-developer
releases.body:
Snake, first playable build: game-developer f3d8e6f2fcce1d67b904fd35d2fb8d673a74b8cd + artist assets 168dbb55bb376666aa61632057c92f126ef20e2f (the delivery as `ht-role delivery` assembles it).

**Start it:** download `snake-v0.1.0.zip`, unzip, open `snake/index.html` in a browser (or `python3 -m http.server` in `snake/` and open http://localhost:8000/). No install, no build.

**Controls:** Enter/Space/click (or an arrow key) start · arrow keys turn · P/Esc pause · Enter/Space/R/click play again · M sound.

**What it does:** 20×20 grid; eating food grows the snake one cell and adds a point; hitting a wall or itself ends the game. Title screen, score and best score during play, game-over screen with the final score and a play-again prompt.

**Checked:** `tests/test_game.py` run headless (Playwright Chromium) on the unzipped delivery: 23/23 checks passed (movement, all four turns, reverse ignored, growth +1, score +1, wall and self game over, final score, play again by Enter and click, tail-following allowed, real-time advance, no page errors). Screenshots: `tests/shots/`.
